description: Aligned 512-square RGB crop of the first frame of an actual local Wan Animate head-crop study. This still supplies identity to LivePortrait; the rejected full crop is not composited into the finished scene.

inputs.text: Character appearance description: A natural-looking man with short wavy dark hair and light stubble, wearing a matte brown field jacket over an oatmeal sweater and charcoal trousers. Background description: A green metal railing on a canal bridge, softly focused leafy trees and buildings, soft natural daylight, realistic contrast.
frozen motion, blurred hands, malformed limbs, extra arms, text, logos
A man talks at a bridge railing, then smiles and turns his head toward the woman on his right. His hands rest near the railing. The camera remains almost stationary.
